The console below runs R directly in your browser with [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/). Nothing is sent to a server. The first visit downloads R and the packages, which takes a few seconds; after that, code runs instantly.

The playground installs the latest build of sicher from GitHub, through [r-universe](https://feddelegrand7.r-universe.dev/sicher).

## Try it

Declare a typed variable, then try to assign a value of the wrong type. Press **Run Code** to see sicher stop it, then edit the code and run it again: try another type such as `String` or `Scalar(Numeric)`, or change the value.

```{webr-r}
library(sicher)

x %:% Integer %<-% 20L

x <- "hello error"
```

To use sicher in your own R session, install it with `install.packages("sicher")`, then head to the [Features](features.qmd) page for everything it can do.
